subject: Data-proofing add-on: fee split, evidence handoffs & SLA credits
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northlanehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northlanehealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data-proofing add-on — fee split + evidence handoff questions

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week — Northlane liked the audit-log retention view and the KMS options. Before we get to contract terms, procurement asked us to scope how the "data-proofing" add-on (audit logs + KMS/HSM + residency evidence for HIPAA) will be charged at pilot vs production. Two quick asks: 

1) Do you have a recommended split between a one-time onboarding/evidence-ingest fee and an ongoing residency surcharge? Our legal team prefers capitalizing onboarding costs rather than a one-off catch-all.
2) We need a proposed language for SLA credits tied to evidence delivery (if audit log exports fail / residency switch causes >4 hours downtime to ingestion).

Also: can you provide a recent SOC2 snapshot and confirm whether audit-log exports over the pilot cap would be billed back to Northlane or absorbed by Redwood during the pilot?

Appreciate a short written proposal so procurement can review.

Best,
Alex Reed
Head of Cloud Ops, Northlane Health
Alex.Reed@northlanehealth.com
(415) 555-0142
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obien@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northlanehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 10:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data-proofing add-on — fee split + evidence handoff questions

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise proposal we can take to procurement; attaching a quick pricing workbook (northlane_pricing_v1.xlsx) with line items.

High-level proposal (pilot → production):
- Onboarding/evidence-ingest fee: $45k one-time for pilot (covers S3 ingestion mapping, test exports, HSM provisioning, and 3rd-party evidence review).
- Amortization option: we can amortize that $45k over 12 months as a monthly credit ($3,750/mo) if you prefer capitalized treatment.
- Recurring residency surcharge: $0.04/token-equivalent for audit-log storage & retrieval; alternatively a fixed $2,000/mo KMS seat for customers who prefer seat licensing (simpler for procurement).
- SLA crediting: if audit-log ingestion fails and causes downstream evidence unavailability > 4 hours, Redwood will issue a pro-rata service credit equal to 5x the daily portion of the monthly residency surcharge for the first outage, escalating to 15x if > 24 hours. We propose this as a limited remedy during the pilot with an agreed cap.

Pilot billing treatment: Redwood will not bill for audit-log overages during the 60-day pilot (we absorb up to 200% of the pilot cap) provided Northlane shares ingestion patterns post-pilot. After pilot, excess ingestion will be billed at the recurring surcharge rate unless we agree a different commit.

Attachments: northlane_pricing_v1.xlsx (line-item breakout).

If that aligns, I'll loop in Legal (Laura) for draft contract language and provide the SOC2 snapshot. Suggest kickoff next Tuesday to align milestones.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 650 555 0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data-proofing add-on — fee split + evidence handoff questions

Connor — couple internal notes before we finalize the external language: 

- Suggest reducing the one-time pilot onboarding fee to $30k for logo/pilot concession, but offer amortization over 12 months only if they commit to a 12-month recurring minimum (helps protect revenue).
- Offer KMS seat at $1,500/mo as a lower-cost alternative; HSM remains a separate line for customers who need FIPS 140-2.
- For SLA credits, let's put a cap at 2x the monthly surcharge for pilot period to avoid large exposure on our side. We can offer 5x as an escalation if they sign a 12-month commit.

I'll flag these in the pricing workbook and send a redline.

Ben
Director, Pricing & Packaging
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northlanehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northlanehealth.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data-proofing add-on — fee split + evidence handoff questions

Connor — thanks, this is helpful. A few follow-ups from procurement & security: 

- Amortization is preferable; procurement will sign off if the monthly amortization is in the cloud services line item (vs a capital expense). 12-month commit is reasonable.
- SLA crediting: Northlane needs explicit language that credits are applied automatically (not claim-based) for ingestion availability incidents tied to Redwood infrastructure. The cap suggestion is fine; we need the first-year cap to be at least 15% of the expected annual residency spend.
- Evidence delivery: we need clarity on handoff format (S3 exports + signed attestations). Can you confirm if Redwood will provide MD5 checksums and timestamped manifests for each evidence batch?

Also: can you share your most recent SOC2 snapshot and confirm whether the SOC2 report covers the KMS/HSM operator process? Procurement will need that to get PO through legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — can we lock language this week?

Best,
Alex
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northlanehealth.com>, procurement@northlanehealth.com
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obien@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data-proofing add-on — fee split + evidence handoff questions

Alex — looping in Stephanie from Legal. Short answers: 

- Automatic credits: we can support an automated crediting mechanism during the pilot tied to monitored ingestion availability. We'll propose sample SLA language that defines measurement windows and automatic trigger thresholds.
- Evidence handoff: Redwood will deliver evidence as compressed S3 manifests (gz) with SHA256 checksums and a timestamped index file; we will include a signed attestations PDF per monthly export.
- SOC2: attaching SOC2-snapshot-2026-06.pdf (redacted) — it covers platform controls and third-party KMS management practices; HSM operator details are in Appendix B.

We're comfortable with the 12-month commit + amortization path; Stephanie will prepare a contract addendum draft with the cap language and an adjustable credits schedule (pilot vs committed).

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0177

Attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2026-06.pdf (redacted)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obien@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data-proofing add-on — fee split + evidence handoff questions

Alex — great progress, thanks all. Quick recap and next steps so procurement has a single action list: 

1) Pricing: pilot onboarding fee: $30k (credit to convert to $3,750/mo amortization for 12 months if Northlane signs 12-month commit). KMS seat option: $1,500/mo; HSM quoted separately. Recurring residency surcharge per workbook after pilot.
2) SLA credits: automatic crediting during pilot; cap = 2x monthly surcharge unless committed 12 months then cap increases per addendum (we will propose 5x after commit). Stephanie will draft exact clause.
3) Evidence handoff: S3 gz manifests + SHA256 index + signed attestations per month (Manifest sample in onboarding-milestones.docx).
4) SOC2: provided (see Laura's attachment).
5) Next actions: Connor to send DocuSign addendum (draft) + kickoff invite for 10/6/2026. Procurement to confirm PO path.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123northlane (draft addendum). Drive checklist: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/Shared/Northlane/OnboardingChecklist

If everything looks good I'll execute the DocuSign for pilot.

Thanks — Connor
